beta.notes:
## 0.1.0-beta.19

- A start-up note from the developer is shown once over Home. Hold OK for a second to close it.
- Media art screensaver (supporter extra): new Options rows "Art changes every" (10 seconds to 5 minutes) and "Art shows title" (on by default, drawn at half opacity). Holding OK for a second over a picture opens that film or show; a tap just ends the screensaver; a hold let go early keeps it running.
- When the router blocks the server's plex.direct name, the message now names the router.
- The Home logo row is now worded "Hide home logo", so a locked row says what it unlocks.
